card.name: The/the before a specific noun
card.fires_on: The word "The" or "the" in general web prose, where it introduces a specific known thing: a title, a named work, or a previously mentioned object.

modes.label: Title start
modes.description: "The" opening a book, poem or work title in a list of works.
modes.example: Coleridge's "<<The>> Rime of the Ancient Mariner".

modes.label: Definite reference
modes.description: "the" after a verb or preposition, pointing to a particular named thing or event.

modes.label: Sentence start
modes.description: "The" starting a new sentence that refers back to a party just mentioned.
modes.example: and likewise also the wife to her husband.<< The>> wife does not have authority

card.plain: It fires on the word "the" when a specific, named or already-mentioned thing is about to follow.
evidence: Coleridge's "<<The>> Rime of the Ancient Mariner".
